notes.title: Update 09/27 Fixes and Fighters
notes.notes:
A few fixes and new things:

- Magnus wing pitch tuning
- Refuel plane day/night glow adjusted
- Upgrade costs balance
- Sensitivity slider for manual mode orbital and lookaround camera speed
- Reverse input now requires short button hold instead of press to prevent accidental reversing
- Hangar damage speech now has a random chance to play instead of all the time
- Fix softlock in the brewery section of the tutorial
- Fix propeller trait bonus not applying to Pearl Grape
- Fix Vapor Rockets detaching after visiting bar
- Fix cockpit camera position to prevent visible pilot goggles in front of the camera
- Missiles use a new interception calculation called Proportional Navigation, which means they will more accurately intercept the target heading, instead of the current simple method of chasing from behind.   Rate of turn has been decreased so the overall difficulty has not increased, but the importance of the first evasive maneuver is increased.  If the first evasion is good then they will generally not turn around and keep chasing you.
- Pirate Fighter planes have been added, these are faster and much more maneuverable than the gunships so they are a bit more difficult to chase down and shoot, however they have less health and do less damage.  
- Fighters and Gunships are used in various combinations, increasing in number as the game goes on.  There may also be additional waves of fighters later in the game, as well as fighter variants that have different behaviours.   In the later game as the number of bosses increases there will remain one gunship/fighter encounter (previously they were all removed).

notes.title: Fixes, tuning, QOL and more plane parts update
notes.notes:
- New wing part for both heavy and light plane
- Gunship patrols planes now deploy a shootable swarm of slow flying kamikaze bomb drones once the player reaches sufficient fame.
- Scavenger Ornament perk now includes bomb drones. Materials or ingredient spawn chance when breaking a camp, gun tower or drone bomb.
- Further tuning of the Vacuum Boost fuselage. Removed health recovery perk in exchange for significant bolstered boosting speed to make it moderately useful for fast travel. Along with a base engine power increase to make it a bit more competitive in combat.
- Manual mode cameras now accept mouse input for looking around (for those using HOTAS or keyboard)
- Camera return input added for manual mode orbital camera, the default binding for this is F on the keyboard, but there is no default gamepad binding because we are out of buttons on the gamepad, so unfortunately if you want to use it with the gamepad you will have to choose something to unbind (I generally get rid of reverse).
- Products panel added archive checkbox so you can choose to hide recipes you don't want to see (also view archived option will display all)
- Product panel add view button which will load the bottle screen again for that brew

- Made the refuel plane easier to spot from afar with a very small pillar of light.
- Fixed an airship boss edge case during the final battle that caused the retreat phase to get stuck.
- Fixed airship sometimes failing to reset tunnel gates after subsequent battles.
- Fixed Madam Minello finger painting taunt whist retreating.
- Fixed smog dome aerial flare occasionally spawning from incorrect pirate.
- The lower ropes on the plane boss now highlight orange when the minion hatch opens to better indicate the vulnerability of the lower engines.
- Reduce chances of over-bright square looking artifacts when flying through particles
- Fixed manual mode plane control was sometimes lost after boosting at high speed
- Fixed inventory duplication going in and out of the hangar with certain heavy plane configurations
- Fixed heavy plane taking damage when exiting hangar due to insufficient buoyancy
- Fixed plane sometimes unexpectedly capsizes when docking at shipyard
- Fixed saving issue that could cause game to freeze when changing settings
- Fixed post final battle save game sometimes spawns plane at old hangar location
- Fixed sometimes repair sound does not stop playing
- Fixed Gojko-Marin story mission encounter could relocate causing mismatch with mission map icon
- Fixed Tumble Frame fuselage would cause unexpected fatal crash when performed near to water or ground
- Fixed tutorial will no longer allow collection of wheat which would cause a softlock
- Fixed Tour plane throttle hud indicator was not showing
- Fixed sunset sky would appear a bit stuttery
- Fixed if Irena is in the plane and flying at night the sky would flash after the ghosts had passed
- Fixed pirate airship boss weakpoints would sometimes not register projectile hits.

Thanks again for supporting the game, we will continue to try and make improvements.

notes.title: Bugfixes and improvements
notes.notes:
- cave mission given more time and more visuals identifiers for slightly easier navigation.
- fireworks mission given 30 more seconds and speculative fix for stuck dialogue.
- fiberhop brews balanced
- boss plane: weakpoints are now correctly impervious to damage when not exposed.
- airship boss: can now properly be defeated unassisted in final battle sequence
- final boss: fixed bombs or alcohol rounds having lacklustre effect on engines. Fixed brief moments of side wall invulnerability.
- final sequence given more time and doubled boss decay rate
- speculative fix for the salvage crates self destructing on start.
- fix pressure washer visual and sound fx don't stop if plane crashes whilst holding ability
- fix alcohol rounds do not drain water charge and will fire when water charge is empty
- fix mouse pointer appears during flight in controller mode after moving mouse or other actions
- fix controller open map input button does not also close map
- fix Darkmoon Shrine does not appear as discovered 
- fix keyboard pitch/roll/yaw inputs have much greater input lag than the same inputs on controller

Changes:
- Recipe book filter by Distilled/Fermented option
- Recipe book sort by name/quality/ingredient option 
- Recipe book remembers its selection until the brewery is exited
- Water Missiles are now a proper secondary weapon, meaning that they must be toggled to using the secondary weapon cycle before they can be used.   They no longer autofire, instead once the lock is achieved they will maintain the lock for a few seconds during which the player can choose to fire one or both missiles, or not at all.  For people who prefer the previous implementation they can choose this by turning on Settings/Controls/Autofire Missiles.  Note that this setting change will only take effect after the plane gets reset by going in an out of the hangar.

Thanks for continuing to play the game and providing feedback, we do take everyone's comments and bug reports on board when deciding what to do next even if we can't always respond to everybody.

notes.title: Bugfix and recipe/contract balancing
notes.notes:
- Fix compact fuselage hydro boost bonus not working
- Fix Irena void visuals sometimes not disappearing correctly
- Prevent docking when Irena void effect is active
- Fix plane stuck detector getting stuck and not resetting the plane
- Fix torpedo could be targeted by copter or auto turrets
- Fix controller navigation issues in the hangar, unable to create new light plane or sell plane
- Fix tumble frame VFX stuck on plane if it crashed
- Fix for unpausing landmark dialogue
- Fix for lower screen UI visuals cut off for widescreen users
- Fix floating bottles in bar
- Camera fixes and softlock prevention in final battle
- Fix bad looking propeller blur
- Pilot traits not working when starting a non-tutorial game
- Fix Pelican and Pipe not offering you a contract on day 1 if you quit the conversation and restarted it
- Fix bar sales panel incorrectly reported fame from sales (modifiers were excluded)
- Contract frequency for bars increased across the board, particularly for The Thirsty Sailor and The Pelican and Pipe

Balance:
- Dijana bad ingredient trait chance reduced from 10% to 5%
- Fame from bar sales reduced by 50%
- Compact frame boost modifier reduced to +1% per cargo unit
- Easy mode repair cost reduced by 75% 
- Easy mode fuel cost reduced by 50%
- Recipe and contract generation limits what it will award according to fame level in Easy and Normal mode.   It works with these ranges:
0 - 10000 only recipes and contracts using group 0 ingredients are awarded (no upgrades needed)
10000-20000 only recipes and contracts with group 0 or group 1 ingredients are awarded (upgrade level 1 required)
20000-30000 group 2 (upgrade level 2)
> 30000 no restrictions.
Hard mode continues to use the existing RNG system without group restrictions.

- Contract quality requirements increase as fame increases for Normal and Hard mode.  For normal mode  > 50k fame contracts will start to require 1*, > 75k it will be 2*.  Hard mode is 30k-50k 1*,  50k-75k 2*, 75-100k 3*.

We hope that these balance changes will make the early game a bit less starved for income as there will be more contracts and the contracts will not require any upgrade purchases.  We know that recipe discovery is is still a major issue and we are working to add more ways to acquire recipes as well as a bit of an overhaul of brewing in general, but that is a bit of a larger job.

notes.title: Bugfix and tuning patch
notes.notes:
Fix ingredients not spawning in post end game
  Fix paints not purchasable under some conditions
  Fix restarting save game from floating market now works
  Fix bar conversation softlock with empty dialogue box
  Fix bar conversation sometimes not displaying player options as menu but playing them sequentially
 Clamp maximum buoyancy to try and avoid planes being catapulted into the sky
  Reset water after salvage minigame to try and prevent unexpected submersion after returning
 More validation when saving, if an unexpected error occurs a message box will appear to take you to the main menu and a prompt to contact us for help
  Save games with no player planes will now load instead of hanging, even though technically you should not have been able to delete all your planes
 The water cost of the standard light plane projectile is decreased, allowing for more shots before a refill is required.
 Brew of 2-5star values decreased by 20-30% because players found they were advancing to the end content far too quickly when higher quality brews were stocked in their bar.  This resulted in players reaching the end without a proper combat plane or enough combat know how, thus the lowering of their value.
 Flight instrument location support added. Your Altitude and Speed can now be positioned on the upper or lower portion of the screen, particularly more useful for widescreen users.


Thanks for your continued patience as we work through the issues, we will continue to put out patches with more fixes and improvements as frequently as we can.

A special note to anyone experiencing issues loading a saved game, please do get in touch with us right away either by email or on discord.  We are often able to fix up save game files so they work and we really don't want anyone to lose their progress.  There are a couple of people who have submitted bug reports and their save games can be restored, but we don't know how to get in touch with them.
